reviewer: Codex, independent claim-to-source assessment of controlled pairs
controls: Question, source evidence, source numbering, model settings and empty fact selection remain identical across all four cases.
Within each pair the claim is identical; only the inline citation number changes.
All candidates pass deterministic rendering and citation-range validation before Critic calls.
Expected labels are recorded for review and are not passed to the model.
No Planner, Writer, embedding or MCP calls occur; only the production Critic is invoked with replayed source evidence.

conclusion: The current Critic accepted all four candidates and failed to distinguish both citation swaps. Application approval is insufficient evidence of claim-to-cited-source support.
limitations: Two selected development pairs, one call per case; do not generalize these counts to model-wide accuracy.
All supporting and non-supporting excerpts are visible in every call. Cross-source support leakage is a hypothesis, not an observed internal reasoning process.
The source text and expected associations were reviewed against local prepared reports, not externally audited.
next_step: Repeat these paired claims with only their cited source available to the semantic check, preserving the original source ID. Compare false acceptance and false rejection before integrating a claim-level verifier.
